scope: A YouTube player with simple keys, and fewer video errors.

topics.title: YouTube player
details: Press Enter on a video and you hear Loading video. Then you are in the player.
In the player, Up and Down Arrow change the volume. Left and Right Arrow skip back and forward.
Space or K plays and pauses. N plays the next video, and P the one before.
Escape goes back to your list, such as your search results. The video keeps playing.
To come back to the player, press Enter on the video that plays, or say Player.
J and L are gone. The arrow keys do the same.

topics.title: Video errors
details: If YouTube says something went wrong, the video loads again once by itself.
If it still will not play, you hear what to do next.
If YouTube asks you to sign in to show you are not a robot, you hear that, and how to sign in.
Chrome in the background keeps its window open, out of sight, so videos keep drawing.
